last_checked.note: 2026-08-20 check: v6.0.0.30 (tag created/published 2026-08-18T02:24:26Z, underlying commit 668ddd7 dated 2026-08-17T21:04:56Z) vs prior-checked v6.0.0.27 (2026-08-13). Two intermediate releases (v6.0.0.28 2026-08-13T21:57:17Z, v6.0.0.29 2026-08-13T20:45:59Z) shipped between checks and were skipped per the skill's stated behavior. Queried from 2026-08-16 (a day before the commit date, per skill guidance) to now, a ~4.5 day window vs. the prior run's ~6 day window -- raw counts aren't directly comparable across runs. Used logs/analytics/aggregate (group_by status) for exact status totals, and a 1000-line /events/search sample (up from the skill's default 50) for message-pattern breakdown. Rollout is broad and healthy across 17 clusters (production x4, staging x2, sandbox x1, preset x2, 8 customer MPC/GCP clusters); production-aws-ap1a still present from last check. Of 54,567 total error-status logs, the top sampled patterns are all previously-known noise: 'Virtual dataset template error: list object has no element 0' (175 explicit + a matching 175-count 'Exception'-titled companion log carrying the same traceback in exc_info -- confirmed by inspecting a sample event; not double-counting two different bugs), authlib deprecation-warning stack-trace fragments (added 'from authlib.jose import JsonWebToken' to known_noise as a safe specific string; left the more generic 'warnings.warn(message, FutureWarning)' and 'It will be compatible before version 2.0.0.' fragments OUT of known_noise since they're too generic and could mask unrelated FutureWarnings -- these still show up in raw error counts). A large customer-specific batch of 'Unexpected metric expression type: ...' warnings (WebRTC/telecom-looking custom SQL metrics, ~140 sampled) is covered by the existing generic 'Unexpected metric expression type' known_noise prefix. Of 12 critical-status logs: 5 are 'WORKER TIMEOUT (pid:N)' (known_noise). The other 2 are NEW and NOT in known_noise: a single Celery beat crash ('beat raised exception <class ValueError>: ValueError("invalid operation on closed shelf")', preceded by a shelve.py KeyError) on pod ws--cd26366c--main-superset-worker-beat in production-aws-us2a at 2026-08-20T15:43:44Z. Confirmed via direct search this exact string has zero hits anywhere in Datadog going back to 2026-07-20 (any version) -- genuinely new, not a rename. Only 1 real incident (2 log lines: a WARNING traceback + a CRITICAL summary for the same event), single pod, no recurrence since. Flagged as NEEDS ATTENTION but low-severity/isolated -- looks like a shelve-file race during beat pod restart rather than a systemic issue; worth a follow-up if it recurs on the next check. Also noted ~113/275 'null message' nginx access-log entries at various upstream_status (500/404/403/400/502) on chart/data and explore_json endpoints -- consistent with downstream effects of the already-known virtual-dataset-template-error class, not flagged separately.
